Keeping my portrait simple today: a black knit and soft window light.

Ask me about a painting and suddenly I'm explaining the whole process with my hands.
A quiet moment at my desk before I get back to the portrait on screen.
I leaned into purple shadows for this one. Here's the portrait up close.
I've been building a little world around this portrait, one colour at a time.
